body:
Fixed a real UX bug: the console's embedded Web Phone already auto-registered via query params, but the login form (extension/password fields) stayed visibly 'active' the whole time, flashing before the dial screen appeared. Now an inline script switches to a Connecting screen before JsSIP even loads, with a real error fallback to the login form only if registration genuinely fails. commit e30e203.

⚓ ☃
title: Web phone auto-connect: skip login screen entirely when SIP creds are already provisioned
